subject: Hosted integration — architect office hours (SDKs, streaming, tool calling)
body:
From: Emily Sanchez <emily.sanchez@veridian.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodai.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — hosted inference architecture deep-dive

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the intro last week. Our platform team at Veridian would like a focused technical deep-dive on Redwood's hosted integration surface so we can validate end-to-end constraints before procurement. Specifically we want to cover SDK usage patterns, streaming + long-running conversations, and guidance on tool/function calling and security boundaries.

Ideal attendees: our lead infra engineer (cc'ed), our product integrator, and whoever owns SDK best practices on your side. Can we book a 60–75 minute session in the week of May 3 — preferably early in the week?

High-level questions to prep:
- How does SDK streaming handle intermittent network disconnects and reconnection semantics?
- Recommendations for KV/prefix caching with stateful sessions across tokens.
- Tool invocation patterns and security (credential passing, least privilege).
- Any required network egress rules or firewall IP ranges for hosted API.

Thanks — happy to send a calendar poll if you prefer times.

Best,
Emily Sanchez
Director of Platform Engineering
Veridian HealthTech

-----
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodai.com>
To: Emily Sanchez <emily.sanchez@veridian.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodai.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — hosted inference architecture deep-dive

Hi Emily — great to hear from you. Appreciate the clear agenda — we can absolutely cover all of that. Soojin (solutions architect) will join and drive the SDK/streaming sections.

Proposed slots (all in PT):
- Mon May 3, 09:00–10:15 (60–75m, preferred)
- Mon May 3, 14:00–15:15
- Tue May 4, 10:00–11:15

Proposed agenda (attached):
1) Intros & goals (5m)
2) SDK patterns and streaming semantics (20m)
   - reconnect/backpressure, chunked/partial responses
   - client-side retry vs server resume
3) Production integration: caching, batching, and stateful sessions (15m)
4) Tool/function calling best practices & security model (15m)
5) Network/firewall requirements + deployment modes (10m)
6) Q&A and next steps (10m)

Attachments: veridian_deepdive_agenda.pdf (agenda + pre-reads), network_requirements.xlsx (sample egress/IPs). If you can confirm which slot works we will send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and a short runbook for architects.

Notes for your infra team: if you expect long-running conversations (TTL > 5k tokens) tell us the typical session length and concurrency so we can propose batching/quantization tradeoffs.

If none of the slots work, send two or three alternatives and we’ll adapt.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodai.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198

-----
From: Emily Sanchez <emily.sanchez@veridian.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@veridian.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodai.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — hosted inference architecture deep-dive

Thanks Aditya — Mon May 3 09:00 PT works for us, but can we shift to 09:30–10:45 PT? That gives Marcus and our timezone-rotated team time to join.

Also please include a short one-page checklist in the invite that calls out any required IP ranges and KMS hints (we'll hand to our security architects).

I'll accept the calendar invite once updated. Zoom link below for now: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=abc123
